Proceeding.
issues: Val/test accuracy gap (~7.2 pp) and the resulting 23× selective-risk gap at 80% coverage (val 0.0011 vs test 0.0258) are inherited from the evaluation stage; they do not affect the comparison arithmetic but should be monitored in any deployment decision.

Label smoothing 0.1 and weight decay 0.001 deviate slightly from architecture-research guidelines for CNN heads; no observed negative impact on either baseline or agentic metrics, noted for reproducibility.
